assertions.claim: Give 15 g of sugar first — sugar cubes or a small juice box; retest after 15 minutes, repeat if still low.
assertions.cn_span: 先吃 15 克糖——方糖、一小盒果汁都行，15 分钟后再测一次，还低就再来一次

assertions.claim: Glucose below 3.0 mmol/L is clinically significant hypoglycemia; when outside help is needed it can be fatal.
assertions.cn_span: 血糖低于 3.0 就是有临床意义的低血糖，到了要别人帮忙才能处理的程度可以致命

assertions.claim: Give nothing by mouth to an unconscious person — it will enter the airway; call 120 immediately.
assertions.cn_span: 意识不清的人一口都别喂，会呛进气管，直接打 120

assertions.claim: The same standard advises glucagon be prescribed to anyone on insulin or at high hypoglycemia risk; nasal spray and prefilled pen are more convenient.
assertions.cn_span: 用胰岛素或低血糖高风险的人都应该配一份胰高血糖素

assertions.claim: Default target is yourself or a diabetic family member — carry sugar for them.
assertions.cn_span: 这条的默认对象是你自己或家里的糖尿病人，随身带糖也是给他们带的
